title: Liquid morph typography
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Brand-colored blobs flow and merge like ink in water, then pinch into the shape behind each headline. Words surface out of the liquid with a per-word rise, and every drop in the music makes the blob ripple outward.
code_snippet: morphPath(blobA, blobB, progress(f, s, 30)); noise2D for wobble; Text reveal word from below

title: Kinetic grid
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: A strict modular grid draws itself, then cells flip, slide and swap on every beat like a Swiss poster in motion. Copy snaps into cells; the grid re-flows at each section change.
code_snippet: cells = 6x10; translate by beatIndex; clip.wipe per cell; StrokeDraw grid lines

title: Paper cut-outs
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Layered paper shapes with soft drop shadows and slightly jittery stop-motion timing (step the frame by 2). Shapes tear in from the edges; type sits on torn paper strips.
code_snippet: const stepped = Math.floor(frame/2)*2; random(seed) rotation jitter; box-shadow layers

title: 3D extrude
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Logo-inspired solid shapes extruded in three.js orbit slowly; on hits the camera punches in and the shapes split apart to reveal text planes.
code_snippet: <ThreeStage><mesh rotation={[0, frame/60, 0]}><torusKnotGeometry/><meshStandardMaterial color={palette.primary}/></mesh></ThreeStage>

title: Data-viz storytelling
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: The brand's real numbers become the protagonist: bars grow on the beat, a line chart draws itself, and the key number counts up and lands on the drop.
code_snippet: CountUp value start duration; StrokeDraw for line chart; bars height = spring

title: Hand-drawn strokes
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Marker-style strokes draw underlines, circles and arrows around key words as if annotated live. Wobbly paths (noise on control points) keep it human.
code_snippet: StrokeDraw d=wobbly path progress; noise2D on points; strokeLinecap round

title: Split-screen collage
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: The frame splits into 2–4 panels that slide and resize; each panel carries a fragment of the story and they rejoin for the logo.
code_snippet: clip.polygon for panels; panel widths animated with springs; Sequence per panel

title: UI assembly
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: An invented product UI assembles piece by piece inside a device frame: cards drop in, toggles flip, a cursor clicks the CTA. Each UI event is a sound cue.
code_snippet: DeviceFrame kind=phone; cards springAt staggered; cursor path with interpolate

title: Typographic wall
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Huge repeated words scroll in opposite directions as a texture wall; the real headline cuts through it in the brand gradient.
code_snippet: rows of repeated text translateX(±frame*speed); gradientText headline on top

title: Particle swarm
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Thousands-of-dots feel (use a few hundred) swarming with noise, then converging into the logo silhouette or a word on the drop.
code_snippet: particle(i, frame) + lerp toward target points on hit; noise3D flow field

title: Light sweeps
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Dark premium canvas; narrow beams of brand light sweep across glossy type and the logo, with lens bloom on hits.
code_snippet: linear-gradient beam translateX; mix-blend screen; blurIn on reveal

title: Geometric pop
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Big flat geometric shapes (circles, triangles, half-moons) pop and bounce on beats, framing short bold words. Bauhaus energy in brand colors.
code_snippet: @remotion/shapes Circle/Triangle; springs.bouncy; rotate on beat pulse

title: Cinematic mask reveals
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Letterboxed frame; every scene is revealed through a moving shape mask (iris, diagonal, text-shaped). Slow push-ins, motion blur on cuts.
code_snippet: clip.circle / clip.diagonal; Camera zoom slow; CameraMotionBlur on transitions

title: Isometric world
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: A tiny isometric world (blocks, roads, parcels) built from CSS 2.5D; the camera glides across it as the story progresses.
code_snippet: transform: rotateX(60deg) rotateZ(45deg); blocks pop with springs; ParallaxLayer

title: Neon line art
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Single continuous neon lines draw icons and arrows that lead the eye from line to line of copy; glow pulses with the beat.
code_snippet: StrokeDraw + filter drop-shadow glow; pulse from useBeat

title: Brutalist type
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Oversized raw type, hard cuts on every beat, inverted color flashes on hits, no easing on some moves for punch.
code_snippet: hard cut via Sequence; invert bg/text on hit.pulse > 0.5

title: Morphing icons
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: One icon morphs into the next to tell the product story (cart → box → truck → smile), each morph on a downbeat.
code_snippet: morphPath between icon paths; Text label under each

title: Orbit system
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: The brand at the center, benefits orbit as satellites with trails; on the drop, orbits collapse into the logo.
code_snippet: positions = cos/sin(frame*speed + i*phase); Trail from motion-blur

title: Glass layers
creator: MotionGX
prompt_text: Frosted glass panels float in parallax over moving brand gradients; copy sits on glass with soft reflections.
code_snippet: backdropFilter blur; ParallaxLayer depth; gradient background moving

title: Ribbon flow
creator: MotionGX

title: Counting machine
creator: MotionGX

title: Pixel mosaic
creator: MotionGX

title: Liquid fill
creator: MotionGX

title: Constellation
